## isPageValueType() function

Whether `type` is a page value type: one [ValueTypeConstructors.page()](./contracts.valuetypeconstructors.page.md) made, with its page shape and the item type it exposes.

## Remarks

Decided from the value type's own composition (its plan and its exposed item type), so it holds for a page built by any copy of this package.
